{{short description|Japanese-Brazilian mathematician}}
[[File:Random Structures in the Brain 060.jpg|thumb|right|Yoshiharu Kohayakawa, in 2017.]]
'''Yoshiharu Kohayakawa''' (Japanese: 小早川美晴; born 1963) is a [[Japanese-Brazilian]] mathematician working on [[discrete mathematics]] and [[probability theory]].<ref name="yoshiabc">{{Cite web |title=Yoshiharu Kohayakawa – ABC – Academia Brasileira de Ciências |url=https://www.abc.org.br/membro/yoshiharu-kohayakawa/ |access-date=2025-07-07 |website=www.abc.org.br}}</ref> He is known for his work on [[Szemerédi's regularity lemma]], which he extended to [[Dense graph#Sparse and tight graphs|sparser graph]]s.<ref>[[László Lovász]] – ''Large Networks and Graph Limits'', p. 395</ref><ref>Bridget S. Webb – ''Surveys in Combinatorics 2005'', p. 227</ref>

==Biography==
Kohayakawa has a PhD advised by [[Béla Bollobás]] at the [[University of Cambridge]] with the dissertation ''External Combinatorics and the Evolution of Random Graphs''.<ref>[https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=48453 Mathematics Genealogy Project – Yoshiharu Kohayakawa]</ref>

According to [[Google Scholar]], as of August 21, 2019, Kohayakawa's works have been cited over 3194 times, and his [[h-index]] is 33.<ref>[https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=EC6p9kIAAAAJ Google Scholar Profile – Yoshiharu Kohayakawa]</ref>

He is a titular member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="yoshiabc" />

Kohayakawa has an [[Erdős number]] of 1.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Celina Herrera de Figueiredo: My Erdös number |url=https://www.cos.ufrj.br/~celina/erdos.html |access-date=2025-07-07 |website=www.cos.ufrj.br}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Erdős |first=Paul |last2=Gyárfás |first2=András |last3=Kohayakawa |first3=Yoshiharu |date=1997-12-01 |title=The size of the largest bipartite subgraphs |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0012365X97000046 |journal=Discrete Mathematics |volume=177 |issue=1 |pages=267–271 |doi=10.1016/S0012-365X(97)00004-6 |issn=0012-365X|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

He was awarded the 2018 [[Fulkerson Prize]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=FAPESP |title=Yoshiharu Kohayakawa, professor no IME-USP, ganha prêmio internacional em matemática |url=https://agencia.fapesp.br/yoshiharu-kohayakawa-professor-no-ime-usp-ganha-premio-internacional-em-matematica/28323 |access-date=2025-07-07 |website=AGÊNCIA FAPESP |language=pt-BR}}</ref>
